material.acceptance_criteria: Browser peers on the CI loopback probe (browser-direct job) and one cross-interface case connect with host or srflx pairs and no relay pair.
material.blocked_by: upstream-wireweave-direct-candidates-blocker-oscraft-1-2 (upstream main HEAD is a71f179, the current pin; no upstream commit carries the candidate changes)
material.description: Pin a71f179 (AnEntrypoint/wireweave, js/client/play.html importmap). No wireweave source in /workspace/oscraft; /workspace/spoint/vendor/wireweave is an empty submodule checkout at ba8850a, so no patch was made. Unverified candidate upstream changes for more direct scenarios: (1) gather host candidates across all interfaces, (2) resolve mDNS-obfuscated host candidates or expose a flag to disable them, (3) keep server-reflexive (srflx) gathering on the configured STUN list.
material.subject: wireweave upstream: direct-connection candidate gathering (not patched here)
material.witness: codesearch literal 'stun:stun' in js/client/ice.js: the default list has server-reflexive STUN entries, so srflx gathering is configured. Host and mDNS candidate gathering is browser behaviour the page cannot set from JavaScript, so that part cannot be changed here. Stale for the actionable parts; the browser-direct witness stays with the existing relay job.
material.witness_plan: ci-status green on browser-direct job after the pin moves.
